title: On the Convergence of Proximal Algorithms for Weakly-convex Min-max Optimization
summary: We study alternating first-order algorithms with no inner loops for solving nonconvex-strongly concave min-max problems. We show the convergence of the alternating gradient descent-ascent algorithm by proposing a substantially simplified proof compared to previous ones. It allows us to enlarge the set of admissible step-sizes. Building on this general reformulation, we also prove the convergence of a doubly proximal algorithm in the weakly convex-strongly concave setting.
